title: Camera (Perspective + Orthographic)
summary: Adds Camera base class with view/projection matrices, PerspectiveCamera and OrthographicCamera subclasses, internal mat4 math (no gl-matrix), and camera-triangle example with viewProj uniform, depth testing, and orbiting perspective camera. Public getters: getPosition, getLookAtTarget, getFieldOfView (perspective only, radians).
handoff_message: Antigravity review complete for "camera". In Cursor, ask the agent to use get_feedback_for_cursor for "camera".
cursor_notes: Fixed mat4.ortho WebGPU Z [0,1]. OrthographicCamera uses left,right,bottom,top order. Added camera-ortho example. camera-triangle aspect updates only on resize. Draw.md already correct.
